privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: Apply the owner's choice on the Calvary hub and read it back
goal: The hub holds what the owner chose, or nothing changes if he chose to leave it
acceptance: A backup of the hub database is taken before any change
The change is made in Setup or the API (no hand-written SQL unless renaming the id needs it, with the owner's OK) and read back with grover_plants
Nothing to do and the step closes if the owner chose to leave both

effort.basis: One or two record edits plus a backup. Estimated 2026-11-26.
